name: browser-use
headline: Scifi-web-prompt: Cyberpunk Website Generator
short_description: AI prompt toolkit that generates futuristic sci-fi tech websites with cyberpunk aesthetics using React, Three.js, and Tailwind CSS. Works with Claude, GPT, and any AI tool.
author: LeastBit

sections.overview:
Scifi-web-prompt is a repository of AI prompts designed to generate futuristic technology company homepages with immersive cyberpunk aesthetics. It provides three formats—Claude Skill, GPT-5 Codex Agent configuration, and universal prompts—all built on React, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, and shadcn/ui. The skill produces websites featuring dark themes, 3D particle backgrounds, glassmorphism design, glowing interactions, and responsive layouts without requiring code modifications. Users can deploy complete, production-ready sci-fi websites by inputting a single prompt into Claude.ai, ChatGPT, GLM, or any compatible AI platform.
AI/machine learning company homepages
Web3 and blockchain project landing pages
Game technology brand showcases
Futuristic product launch pages
The AI Prompt Toolkit is designed to streamline the creation of futuristic and immersive content for [COMPANY]. This toolkit includes prompts for Claude Skills, GPT Codex, and general-purpose prompts, all accessible through an intuitive and visually striking interface.
